items.title: Record two-host review evidence for the owner-session execution plan
items.context: Before runtime implementation begins, bind fresh two-host review evidence to docs/requirements/decisions/owner-session-contract-execution-plan.md. Reviews must explicitly check the local/non-cryptographic boundary, generated-token fallback, ppid degradation, and migration away from core host-specific exceptions.
items.userSees: The evidence summary contains "PASS owner-session plan-review evidence: 2 independent hosts reviewed the bound plan and found no blocking contract issue" before runtime code changes begin.

happy.desc: Two independent host providers review the current owner-session execution plan hash/HEAD and both return PASS for local-boundary, generated-token, ppid-degraded, and no-core-host-exception checks.

edge.desc: A duplicate review from the same host provider or same local session is not counted as satisfying the two-host evidence requirement.

adversarial.desc: A review that claims local owner-session evidence is Authority/full production proof is rejected or recorded as non-passing for this pre-code gate.

items.title: Introduce host-neutral owner-session resolver facade
items.context: Create a shared resolver module/facade that returns canonical session id, source, provider diagnostics, and degraded status. Existing owner lease behavior should pass through this facade without weakening current lease semantics.
items.userSees: `lattice session_brief` shows "owner session: <id> [explicit-env]" for canonical env and "owner session: <id> [derived-ppid]" only for degraded fallback.

happy.desc: Canonical LATTICE_SESSION_ID resolves through the shared facade with stable id/source and owner-lease refresh recognizes the same session across ppid changes.

edge.desc: Blank or whitespace-only LATTICE_SESSION_ID is ignored and falls through to adapter or fallback resolution without producing an empty owner id.

adversarial.desc: The resolver result is labeled local coordination only and cannot be consumed as Authority/reviewer proof.

items.title: Move host-specific session signals to adapter boundary
items.context: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity/agy, and fake future-host handling belong in adapter/facade code, not generic owner-lease, lifecycle, gate, or cli-engine paths. Core should consume the canonical resolver result only.
items.userSees: The guardrail prints "PASS owner-session host-native env guardrail: no generic core host-session env reads" while adapter diagnostics still mention codex, claude-code, antigravity/agy as provider labels.

happy.desc: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity/agy, and fake future host adapter inputs map into the canonical resolver result without changing generic owner-lease call sites, and dispatch/provider launch paths preserve or set LATTICE_SESSION_ID at the adapter/env boundary.

edge.desc: Provider labels are diagnostic only; two providers with the same canonical session id are treated as the same local owner session, while broader Gemini-to-Antigravity migration remains out of scope.

adversarial.desc: A new host-native env name appearing in generic owner-lease/lifecycle/gate/cli-engine files fails the guardrail check; adapter and dispatch boundary files remain the only allowed provider-specific session bridge locations.

items.title: Add generated-token fallback and runtime artifact hygiene
items.context: Hosts with a session boundary but no native stable env need stable generated-token fallback using approved runtime/session storage. Any persisted token path must be registered as a runtime artifact and ignored/material-safe.
items.userSees: The smoke output includes "PASS owner-session generated-token fallback: stable token reused and runtime artifact ignored" and `git status --short` shows no token file as a material change.

happy.desc: A host adapter with no native stable env but a stable adapter session key receives a generated local token that is reused across resolver calls.

edge.desc: Generated token persistence is scoped by project root, host provider, and adapter session boundary so different sessions do not collide.

adversarial.desc: The generated token storage path is registered/ignored as a runtime artifact and does not enter material evidence or dirty git output.

items.title: Replace lifecycle and DEV-claim ad hoc session reads
items.context: Lifecycle event collection and DEV-claim warnings should use the same canonical owner-session resolver as story owner leases, so one local session is recognized across repeated invocations.
items.userSees: A repeated `story_advance` or DEV-claim check with the same canonical session no longer prints "already claimed for development" solely because parent PID changed.

happy.desc: Lifecycle event collection records session id/source through the same owner-session resolver used by story owner leases.

edge.desc: When no canonical or adapter session exists, lifecycle diagnostics label the derived ppid path as degraded rather than treating it as a durable host session.

adversarial.desc: Transition/DEV-claim code no longer directly reads host-specific session env vars such as CLAUDE_SESSION_ID or provider-native names.

items.title: Add guardrail tests and multi-host verification matrix coverage
items.context: Update story-owner lease smoke coverage and add a guardrail check so host-native session env names are permitted only in adapter files/tests/docs. Verify canonical env, blank env, adapter bridge, generated-token, ppid degraded fallback, owner gate, lifecycle event, and material hygiene cases.
items.userSees: Verification prints "✓ story-owner-lease smoke passed", "PASS owner-session host-native env guardrail", and "PASS owner-session runtime matrix: codex + claude-code/agy evidence recorded" after `npm --prefix packages/main run build` succeeds.

happy.desc: Build and focused smoke tests pass for canonical env, adapter bridge, generated token fallback, ppid degradation, owner gate, lifecycle events, material hygiene, and runtime two-host matrix evidence.

edge.desc: The runtime matrix uses Codex plus Claude Code when available, and may degrade to Antigravity/agy only with an explicit unavailable note for Claude; local evidence remains non-Authority.

adversarial.desc: A deliberately broad grep for CLAUDE/CODEX/AGY/ANTIGRAVITY session env names reports no forbidden generic-core matches and any runtime host verdict claiming Authority proof is rejected.

items.title: Record parent-PID-changing owner-session transcript evidence before runtime code
items.context: Before changing runtime code, record manual transcript evidence for at least two parent-PID-changing invocation shapes that preserve LATTICE_SESSION_ID and one degraded comparison with no canonical/env adapter signal. Each transcript must include story id, command, host provider, cwd, git HEAD, material hash or document hash, observed session id/source, owner lease before/after summary, and pass/fail result.
items.userSees: The pre-code transcript section contains "PASS parent-pid transcript: canonical session reused lease across two invocation shapes; degraded ppid-only path labeled derived-ppid" before source edits begin.

happy.desc: Two parent-PID-changing invocation shapes preserve the same LATTICE_SESSION_ID and refresh/reuse the same owner lease without foreign-owner rejection.

edge.desc: The degraded comparison without canonical env, adapter signal, or generated token shows distinct ppid-derived ids or an explicit degraded warning.

adversarial.desc: The transcript records story id, command, host provider, cwd, HEAD/material hash, observed session id/source, owner lease before/after, and pass/fail; incomplete transcript evidence is not accepted.
